title: I built a Half-Life 2 kart racer with Claude Code. No AI art: it builds every asset from your own copy of the game
author: lonagi
selftext:
Play it free (Windows) [https://lonagi.itch.io/hl2-kart](https://lonagi.itch.io/hl2-kart)



Half-Life 2: Kart is a Mario Kart-style racer.

12 racers from Half-Life 2 and Half-Life (Alyx, Kleiner, the G-Man, Gordon and others), five 2 km circuits from City 17 to Xen, HL2 items like manhacks and gravity gun, and online multiplayer. It runs on Godot, and Claude Code wrote most of code while I directedd and playtested.

The download contains no art at all. On the first launch, Python scripts read your Half-Life 2 and Half-Life installs and convert the models, textures, sounds and music on your machine. Every character, prop and sound in game is Valve's original.

Each circuit is a 200 to 300 line Python file describing a spline of stretches: street, tunnel, bridge, cutting, jump. A shared generator turns it into road, terrain, walls and props. When I told the agent the first tracks felt tiny, it rebuilt all four as 2 km circuits.

What helped most were test scenes it can run headless. AI-only races that print lap times, rescues and the spots where bots got stuck, photo tours that screenshot every track, and a menu check that renders each screen at several resolutions. The agent looks at the screenshots and fixes what it sees



The project is open source on GitHub so to play you need hl2 and Half-Life on Steam. It's free, non-commercial and not affiliated with Valve!

Happy to answer questions about the workflow ))
